origin.description: Update the value, and optionally the title and label, of a winProgressBar.
origin.usage: setWinProgressBar(pb, value, title = NULL, label = NULL)

arguments.name: value
arguments.text: The new value. NA and out-of-range values are ignored.

arguments.name: title, label
arguments.text: Replacement text. The label is updated only when the bar was created with one.

origin.details: Returns the previous value. This R does not export the function.

translation.description: Update the stored value, title, and label, and return the previous value.

arguments.name: value
arguments.text: None reads the current value. A finite value inside the range replaces it.

arguments.name: label
arguments.text: Ignored when the bar was created with an empty label.

translation.details: The return value is the value from before the call, matching the C function.
translation.example:
from utils import setWinProgressBar, winProgressBar
bar = winProgressBar(min=0, max=100, initial=50, label="info")
print(setWinProgressBar(bar, 75, "test", "75% done"))
